bends.note: jogs about 28 px south at Roote Alley: centreline y 2642 west of it, y 2670 east of it

ends.note: alley printed only as ALLEY, running east from College Street on the line of L'Hommedieu Alley, dead-ends at a building wall short of Vine

notes: Garfield Place (126 ft, central esplanade) meets Vine offset from East 8th Street: Garfield centreline y 1179 (block lines y 961/1397), East 8th east of Vine (block lines y 1167/1397, Volume 2 side, unlabelled here, name from key map) centreline y 1282, so two T-junctions on Vine. BALDWIN and JOHNSON are printed with no suffix (both 10 ft alleys between Piatt Alley and W 7th); each continues north to Garfield Place as an unnamed 10 ft alley (the first two 'alleys' entries), so their Piatt Alley junctions are crossings. Piatt Alley crosses Vine into an alley on the Volume 2 side (east arm centre y 1770, name not readable on the key map). The Vine/? T at y 3015 is an alley entering from the east (Volume 2 side) between 6th and 7th; the vol 2 key map seems to label it GAND/GANO but it can't be read with confidence. Roote Alley runs only between L'Hommedieu (north) and Borden (south). Borden Alley ends at College Street (no alley on the east side). Shillito Place enters Race from the west only. Race and Vine drift about 15 px left from top to bottom of the sheet (scan skew).
